req-1.summary: Native JSON encoding remains in toScriptBody and diagnostic getters in JsonLdDocument.ts, NodeRef.ts and Conformance.ts outside the diagnostic's Effect-context scope.
req-1.fix: Use Result.getOrThrow with S.encodeResult(S.fromJsonString(S.Json)) for document JSON and S.fromJsonString(S.String) for quoted diagnostic fields in all three source files. Preserve diagnostic bytes and public types, combine document encoding with req-2 escapes, and retain upstream assertions; avoid sync codec APIs.

req-2.summary: toScriptBody uses three native string replacement calls outside native-runtime hotspot enforcement.
req-2.fix: Import Str from effect/String and pipe from effect/Function. Pipe the req-1 JSON text through Str.replace for global less-than, greater-than and ampersand matches, retaining the literal backslash-u003c, backslash-u003e and backslash-u0026 bytes. Preserve existing serializer assertions; no test rewrite is required.

req-3.summary: validateResult duplicates schema policy defaults and named LiteralKit values with raw report/ignore/fail literals.
req-3.fix: Hoist a constant for each default from the policy kit Enum and share it between withDecodingDefault and the per-field fallback. Use policy kit .is helpers or .Enum values for comparisons. Preserve tolerant out-of-union input behavior, explicit undefined handling and every upstream test line; do not decode the whole options object.

req-4.summary: Recognized JSON-LD @list and @set containers hide references from identifier validation and graph-closure checks in both lab and pinned upstream.
req-4.fix: After the orchestrator supplies the section-14 upstream-bug receipt, extend the shared referencesOf collector for @list/@set reference contents while retaining property names, discovery order and deduplication. Exclude value objects including @json and unrelated nested objects. Add missing/present target, malformed-id, order and value-object regressions in JsonLdDocument.test.ts and Conformance.test.ts without weakening upstream assertions. Do not edit the ledger or README Port notes.

req-5.summary: The S3 decodePairs rewrite unconditionally coerces missing indices to NaN; prior law-compliant code retained upstream decodeRow and missing-index checks.
req-5.fix: Restore the upstream decodePairs shape: destructure decodeRow(row), then MutableHashMap.set only when both indices are defined. Remove the generated-pairs comment and duplicated Str.split/Number coercion in decodePairs. Retain the forced Effect collection replacement and Str.split inside decodeRow. No upstream test lines were rewritten by this S3 change, so keep them unchanged; do not redesign the restore solely for coverage.
